HEADER: Init +8; Senses Dragon senses, see in darkness; Perception +15
DEFENSE: AC 24, touch 13, flat-footed 20 (+4 dex, +11 natural, -1 size)
DR 5/magic; Immune Shadow, Paralysis, Sleep; SR 21
OFFENSE: Melee Bite +16 (2d6+7), 2 Claws +16 (1d8+5), 2 Wings +14 (1d6+2), Tail Slap +14 (1d8+7)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 5 ft. (10 ft. with bite)
Special Attacks Black Waves, Breath Weapon (80-ft. line, 6d10 shadow damage, Reflex DC 19 half, usable every 1d4 rounds)
At will - bleed, dark orb, detect magic, message, read magic
2nd (DC 20) - dark II, death armor, death knell
3rd (DC 21) - blacklight, dark III, darkra, dispel, haste, infect (DC 20)
4th (DC 22) - bestow curse (DC 21), dark IV, dread spikes, greater fear, slay living (DC 21)
STATISTICS: Str 20, Dex 18, Con 16, Int 12, Wis 12, Cha 24
Base Atk +12; CMB +18; CMD 29 (33 vs. trip)
Feats Combat Casting, Elemental Focus (Dark), Improved Initiative, Lightning Reflexes, Multiattack, Power Attack
Skills Fly +12, Intimidate +21, Knowledge (arcana) +15, Perception +15, Spellcraft +15, Stealth +22, Survival +15; Racial Modifiers +8 Stealth
SPECIAL ABILITIES: Black Waves (su) As a standard action, a black dragon spreads dark waves from herself. All creatures within a 30 ft.-radius must make a Reflex save (DC 23) for half damage or take 3d6+12 points of shadow damage. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 3rd level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 21).

Fearful Bay (su) Once every 1d3 rounds as a standard action, a black dragon howls, all creatures within a 30-foot spread except evil outsiders must succeed at a DC 23 Will save or become panicked for 1d4 rounds. This is a sonic, mind-affecting fear effect. A creature that successfully saves cannot be affected by the same black dragon's fearful bay for 24 hours. This is a mind-affecting fear effect. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 4th level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 23).

Ragnarok (su) Once every 1d4 rounds as a standard action, the black dragon devours the sun, plunging the area into supernatural darkness for 1d4+1 rounds. This affects an area of 120 feet and cannot be dispelled except by a daylight spell. All creatures gain total concealment and vision equivalent to a hume in darkness. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 5th level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 25).
See in Darkness (su) A black dragon can see perfectly in darkness of any kind, including that created by the blacklight spell.

curation.summary: Juvenile Black Dragon is packaged as an FFD20 NPC actor with 41 generated item(s) across 8 populated mechanics categories.
rulesDecisions: Actor data preserves the source statblock in biography and builder flags before any Foundry runtime hydration.
Only true feats, spells, and inventory placeholders are eligible for compendium lookup during import; creature-specific special abilities remain custom generated features.
Racial hit dice are generated from the creature type and source hit dice instead of creating class levels.
Source defensive text is mapped into FFD20 trait fields while unusual FF defenses remain preserved as custom text.
Natural attack items use source attack totals, source damage dice, and manual extra attacks for full-attack routines.
Spell and spell-like ability lines create spell placeholders that should hydrate from installed FFD20/PF spell compendiums.
Skill ranks are reverse-calculated from source totals after ability modifiers, racial modifiers, size modifiers, and class-skill bonuses.
